draft.subject: Question about the Firmware Engineer role at WindBorne
draft.body:
My name is Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I saw you are on the firmware team at WindBorne and wanted to reach out since I just applied for the Firmware Engineer opening, and you are doing the exact kind of work I would be stepping into.

My background is in bare metal embedded C on STM32, writing low level drivers for I2C, UART, and ADC peripherals directly against the datasheet, along with FreeRTOS task coordination and sensor integration work on a Jetson controlled robotics pipeline. Debugging has been the constant thread across all of it, most recently tracing a set of integration failures on a voice controlled robotic arm down to a servo brown out condition.

I would love to hear a bit about what the day to day firmware work at WindBorne actually looks like, if you are open to a short chat sometime.
draft.hook_used: Same technical domain and near-identical job title, direct engineering peer at the target company doing the job applied for
